LOAD REQUIRED LIBRARIES
```{r}
library(dplyr); library(lidR); library(rlas); library(sp); library(rgdal); library(plyr); library(geosphere); library(psych);library(tidyr); library(data.table); library(sf); library(grid); library(ggplot2); library(maptools); library(scales); library(igraph); library(Matrix); library(purrr); library(lattice); library(EnvStats)
```

LOAD las FILES (AIRBORNE LIDAR DATA) OBTAINED ORIGINALLY FROM MARYLAND'S PUBLIC WEBPAGE https://imap.maryland.gov/pages/lidar-download
```{r}
## las tiles from forest habitat of interest
  #Get UMBC38 tile at "https://drive.google.com/file/d/1duh2P3zqqAmQXOOSLNd0OF3sjFgJPVTp/view?usp=drive_link"
  #Get UMBC39 tile at "https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ukd7Z_DWcmvYHRvenf3GS6CXsYyBlKar/view?usp=drive_link"

## load tiles 38 and 39
UMBC38 <- readLAS("/Users/ojpar/Documents/AI related files/UMBC_038.las")
UMBC39 <- readLAS("/Users/ojpar/Documents/AI related files/UMBC_039.las")

## merge las files then reduce file size by clipping the entire region - use a 350 meter radius around habitat of interest
UMBClasFull <- rbind(UMBC38, UMBC39)
UMBClas <- lidR::clip_circle(UMBClasFull, 352251, 4346015, 350)
plot(UMBClas) ## Visualize using RGL, produces 3D elevation-gradient map
```


EXTRACT LIDAR POINTS FOR HABITAT OF INTEREST - CLIP THE las FILE USING GEOMETRIC SHAPEFILE (PRODUCE IN QGIS)
```{r}
## Site polygon - will be used to further clip the las
  #Get zip with shp files at "https://drive.google.com/file/d/1VuYiK7MQeEz_OwlimFTLFL2xGci3NVDA/view?usp=sharing"
PPshape <- sf::read_sf("/Users/ojpar/Documents/AI related files/UMBC_Pond1/UMBC_Pond1.shp"); plot(PPshape)

## Make sure geographic coordinate reference system for the las and polygon are the same by transforming
crsUMBClas <- st_crs(UMBClasFull) ## grab crs from las
trnsUMBCshape <- sf::st_transform(PPshape, crsUMBClas) # use las crs to transform shapefile

## Note - this shapefile stored in text at the bottom of this notebook

# Clip las using the polygon (shapefile)
PPlas = clip_roi(UMBClas, trnsUMBCshape) # new merged file named after pigpen pond forest
plot(PPlas) # Visualize

lidR::writeLAS(PPlas, "/Users/ojpar/Documents/AI related files/UMBClas.las")
```
